camera.projection: Straight back/posts and supports; rectangular hard seat with horizontal/vertical parallel edges. No diagonal footprint, yaw or three-quarter view.

registration.method: One entire1024x1536frame maps once to256square for frame, seat, supports and masks. Reconstructed cardinal camera, no separate bbox fitting.

palette.detail: Native hard plank seat y; tint does not imply cloth
palette.neutral: Equal RGB in both production layers; no baked cyan or wood pigment

state_owner: One fixed native furniture tile. Camera correction does not invent facing selection or an occupied graphic.
native_behavior: Preserve native sitting,20-weight non-takeable organic furniture, cover/non-occlusion and rare animated/custom native fallback.
